text: {"lessons":["Selling winners felt good, but trimming them early did not prevent my account from losing value; I should base sales on each stock’s prospects, not the comfort of a realized gain.","I waited through substantial losses before selling D, E, and A. I should reassess losing positions sooner and be willing to act without treating a sale as an admission of failure.","Several months of inaction coincided with a continuing decline in account value. Even though I trade rarely, I should review my holdings periodically and decide deliberately whether to hold, sell, or rebalance."]}
